I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-team message. I noted that the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form is now due 26 July, replacing the 14 December date they posted this morning.

I also pointed out that 26 July has already passed, since today is 14 October 2026. I asked them to confirm whether finance's sheet means 26 July next year, or whether the date is wrong. I did nothing else, as they asked.

A signing deadline isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the team channel.
